descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S19 Save & Extract and Hospital pre-round harvest time: AI call time vs total, model recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Timing: each Save & Extract run and each Hospital pre-round task harvest logs its AI call time separately from the total; any run over 30 s where the AI service was not the cause is reviewed (target, … (UAT 3.5)
  • U12 Each run records which AI ran each step: the model for task extraction (parsing.extractTasks) and for the Hospital pre-round processing, and whether the backup model was used (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.1)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The S04 + S05 fixtures, including the H-01…H-05 pre-round notes

When Run each fixture's Save & Extract call once more, and each Hospital fixture's pre-round processing (parsing.parsePreRoundNotes and the post-note parsing.extractTasks harvest), timing each call and reading its aiCallLog row right after it

Then Each call answers; providerMs and durationMs logged separately with the model id and any fallback, for both steps

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): maxMs 30000 per call, flagged for review, not Fail (3.5, Q9); a row without providerMs is a finding (3.5 'logs how long the AI call itself took'). The Hospital harvest is the background step behind UAT step 1, so its time is what the physician waits for the three tasks

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
